_readme: Single source for the en/ site root (nav, SEO, catalog, sitemap). Human-readable fields are translation units tracked in i18n/ledger.json. Rebuild with: SITE_ROOT=en node scripts/build_nav.js

site.title: Nginx Proxy Manager reverse proxy guide
site.subtitle: Bring your home services online, safely
site.description: A 12-chapter Nginx Proxy Manager tutorial: HAOS add-on install, first login, Proxy Host, DNS and SSL, then Cloudflare Tunnel, Access Lists, backup, security and troubleshooting.
site.footerMeta: Screens and workflows follow the official Nginx Proxy Manager interface. Nginx Proxy Manager is a trademark of its owner; this site is not affiliated with it.

strings._readme: Site-specific chrome overrides for the en/ root: this site's pager and hub-link labels carry MDI icons (the old generator's markup). Wording follows i18n/strings.en.json; only the icon markup is site-specific.

chapters.title: Getting to know Nginx Proxy Manager
chapters.card: Understand reverse proxies, domains, DNS and HTTPS first, then confirm what problems NPM solves.
chapters.description: Nginx Proxy Manager basics: reverse proxy, DNS, HTTPS, the security boundaries of a public service, and deployment options compared.

chapters.title: Install Woow Nginx Proxy Manager
chapters.card: Add the WoowTech NPM add-on to Home Assistant and check ports 80, 81 and 443.
chapters.description: Install the Woow Nginx Proxy Manager add-on on Home Assistant OS: add the repository, install it, then check the ports and the startup.

chapters.title: First login and account security
chapters.card: Log in with the default credentials, then change the email and password immediately to protect the admin interface.
chapters.description: Nginx Proxy Manager first login: the default account, changing the password immediately, admin port 81 and the basic security settings.

chapters.title: The admin interface and the core objects
chapters.card: Get to know Proxy Hosts, Certificates, Access Lists, Streams and Users.
chapters.description: A tour of the Nginx Proxy Manager admin interface: Hosts, SSL Certificates, Access Lists, Streams and Users.

chapters.title: Create your first Proxy Host
chapters.card: Point an external domain at Home Assistant, a NAS or another internal service.
chapters.description: Nginx Proxy Manager Proxy Host guide: Domain Names, Forward Hostname/IP, Port, WebSocket and testing.

chapters.title: DNS and domain resolution
chapters.card: Create A/CNAME records, and understand public IPs, Cloudflare Proxy and DNS propagation time.
chapters.description: Nginx Proxy Manager DNS guide: A records, CNAME records, Cloudflare Proxy, public IP, NAT and resolution checks.

chapters.title: Request and manage SSL certificates
chapters.card: Get a certificate with HTTP-01 or DNS-01, turn on Force SSL and confirm automatic renewal.
chapters.description: Nginx Proxy Manager SSL guide: Let's Encrypt, HTTP-01, DNS-01, Force SSL, HSTS and certificate renewal.

chapters.title: Cloudflare Tunnel with NPM
chapters.card: Publish through a Tunnel instead of opening router ports, and let NPM handle the internal reverse proxy.
chapters.description: Cloudflare Tunnel with Nginx Proxy Manager: no open 80/443, external HTTPS, the internal reverse proxy and the source IP.

chapters.title: Access Lists and access restrictions
chapters.card: Protect the web services you proxy with Basic Auth, IP allowlists and denylists.
chapters.description: Nginx Proxy Manager Access Lists guide: Basic Auth, IP allowlists, denylists and minimal exposure.

chapters.title: Redirects, Streams and WebSocket
chapters.card: Handle 301/302, TCP/UDP forwarding, WebSocket and custom Nginx config.
chapters.description: Advanced Nginx Proxy Manager features: Redirection Hosts, Streams, WebSocket, Custom Locations and Nginx config.

chapters.title: Backup, updates and hardening
chapters.card: Back up SQLite, the certificates and the config, then plan updates, admin interface protection and least privilege.
chapters.description: Nginx Proxy Manager operations: Home Assistant backups, SQLite, SSL certificates, updates, port 81 and hardening.

chapters.title: Common errors and full diagnosis
chapters.card: Locate the problem layer by layer, from DNS, ports, upstream and 502 through to SSL and Cloudflare.
chapters.description: Nginx Proxy Manager troubleshooting: DNS, 80/443, 502 Bad Gateway, SSL, Cloudflare, WebSocket and logs.
